hypothesis: Principle P3 of the thought experiment v3: the 'now' of distant events is not universal; two inertial observers are related by the Lorentz boost of the parent action's local frame, so the offset of 'now' is dt' = -gamma beta dx and the Doppler shifts of co- and counter-propagating resonant lasers obey nu_a nu_p / (nu_1 nu_2) = 1 exactly (derived in wave O7 by boosting the photon four-vector, with a negative control). Predicted epsilon = sqrt(nu_a nu_p / (nu_1 nu_2)) - 1 = 0 for 7Li+ ions at beta = 0.338. An absolute-time alternative (no relativity of simultaneity, no time dilation) predicts epsilon = gamma - 1 = 0.0625.

observable.domain: 7Li+ ions stored at beta = 0.338 (Botermann et al. 2014), laser frequencies near 384 and 777 THz

prediction_method.description: epsilon and sigma_epsilon from the four registered frequencies (independent errors); z = |epsilon|/sigma_epsilon; the registered frequencies must also reproduce the published (1.5 +- 2.3)e-9 within 0.1e-9, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

fixed_parameters: frequencies and uncertainties exactly as registered
error propagation as independent errors, as in the source
pass_criterion: PASS if z <= 2 and the registered frequencies reproduce the published epsilon and its uncertainty.
fail_criterion: FAILED if z > 3; INCONCLUSIVE if 2 < z <= 3, or if the registered frequencies do not reproduce the published epsilon.
note: Disclosure: drafted after reading the published result epsilon = (1.5 +- 2.3)e-9 and after recomputing it from the four frequencies (1.47e-9 +- 2.30e-9, z = 0.64), so the outcome is effectively known. Scope, stated plainly: an Ives-Stilwell observable tests the time-dilation factor gamma together with the relativity principle (invariance of atomic frequencies and of the light phase velocity under the boost); relative simultaneity is the other half of the same Lorentz time transformation, and in the Robertson-Mansouri-Sexl framework it is separated only with Michelson-Morley and Kennedy-Thorndike results, which are not tested here. So this card tests P3 only as part of the Lorentz time transformation, not as an isolated statement about simultaneity. The rest-frame frequencies nu_1 and nu_2 come from earlier independent measurements; the Doppler-shifted ones from this experiment. The physics is standard special relativity; any Lorentz-invariant theory passes; not UET-distinct. The boost, the offset -gamma beta dx, the boost invariance of the parent-action response Green function and the negative controls (absolute-time Doppler shift, Galilean cone) are checked in docs/core/05_tests/physics/test_lorentz_time.py.
